_comment: The seven-beat arc's candidate pool. Every version plays all seven beats in this order, one pick per beat, so editing a pool edits the piece. An entry is one contiguous stretch of one source: the renderer plays exactly [in, out] of that source's source.mp4 and nothing re-derives it, so in/out can be nudged by hand. `reads` appears where the source is not in English and is the translation the beat was matched on; the spoken words are still what gets cut and shown. Beat 7 has no pool of its own - `pool_from: 1` means it draws from beat 1's, and the draw guarantees a different entry than beat 1 took. Candidates are 2.0-4.25s so every one of them fits every slot without clipping a word. Rebuild with scripts/build_beats.py; it overwrites this file, so hand edits belong in version control.
